response.rationale: The English sense is correctly represented by both answers: Indonesian “barusan” and Malaysian Malay “sebentar tadi” both naturally mean “just now” or “a short time ago.” The different-common-word relation is appropriate despite shared alternatives such as “baru saja/baru sahaja.”
